say:0:1013825001:0.text: Things have reached an end... I didn't expect it to finish like this...
say:0:1013825001:0.source_cn: 事情算是告一段落了……没想到竟然是这样的结局……
say:0:1013825001:0.male: Things have reached an end... I didn't expect it to finish like this...
say:0:1013825001:0.female: Things have reached an end... I didn't expect it to finish like this...

say:1:1013825002:0.text: It may still be dangerous here, please retreat to the square for now.
say:1:1013825002:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，恶魔裂隙可能还有隐患，请先行撤退到广场那里吧。
say:1:1013825002:0.male: It may still be dangerous here, please retreat to the square for now.
say:1:1013825002:0.female: It may still be dangerous here, please retreat to the square for now.

say:2:1013825003:0.text: We can also discuss future plans there, considering the Hypogeans have reappeared...
say:2:1013825003:0.source_cn: 也好，在那里也问问大家的打算吧，毕竟恶魔再度现身了……
say:2:1013825003:0.male: We can also discuss future plans there, considering the Hypogeans have reappeared...
say:2:1013825003:0.female: We can also discuss future plans there, considering the Hypogeans have reappeared...
